questions: Should the function follow redirects (e.g., HTTP 301/302) when fetching the webpage, and if so, how many redirects are allowed?

If the title tag exists but contains only whitespace or is empty, should it return that whitespace/empty string or the 'No title tag found' error?
Should the URL extraction regex allow URLs without http/https scheme (e.g., www.example.com) or require the scheme?
If the webpage contains malformed HTML (e.g., unclosed tags), how should BeautifulSoup parse it (which parser, and should errors be tolerated)?
Should the function strip leading/trailing whitespace from the extracted title string before returning it?
If the URL extraction finds a match but the matched string contains trailing punctuation (like a period), should that punctuation be included in the URL used for fetching?
What is the maximum allowed size for the HTTP response content to avoid memory issues?
